title: fix: address main promotion blockers
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Caps generated video duration at 120 seconds across simplified and OpenAI-compatible routes.
- Proves disconnect/rejoin caching, one upstream call, one wallet debit, and one billed event.
- Limits community reference parsing to video models and fixes the Newest sort URL behavior.
- Corrects the GLM-5.3 Flash availability note.
- Documents that request-wide media deadlines require a concrete provider or product contract.

gist.headline: Videos Learn Their Limits
gist.blurb: The video garden now has a sensible fence: generations stop at 120 seconds, while reconnecting clients keep sharing the same upstream work and wallet charge. A few stray sorting and model-note weeds were pulled too.
gist.summary: Capped video generation at 120 seconds on simplified and OpenAI-compatible routes, preserved one upstream generation, wallet debit, and billed event across disconnect/rejoin requests, and fixed community-video reference parsing plus the Newest sort URL behavior.
gist.impact: Video users get predictable 120-second maximums and reliable reconnect behavior without duplicate generation or billing, while the models page keeps its newest-first view and video references accurate.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful film gardener placing a friendly 120-second marker beside a cozy video-generation reel, while a single glowing cable branches to reconnecting little terminals without creating duplicate reels or coins. Include a retro model-browser screen correctly sorted as Newest, with code-plants and flowers making the reliability fixes feel like garden maintenance.
